milestone.title: raul Autopilot lane — picker and per-drive override panel

intent.outcome: The Autopilot lane surfaces a milestone picker (filtered to autopilot-eligible lifecycles per A1's session.json model) and a per-drive override panel that captures topology, per-role model/harness/skill overrides, and refresh interval — overrides persist into session.json on Start and override `mp config.json` defaults for that session only.

problem.description: The legacy Watch lane (M179) shipped with a picker and ordered queue, but the autopilot redesign adds per-drive overrides (per the locked decisions: persisted in session.json, override only this session). The picker needs to honor the role-config resolution chain from B1 (session.json wins over config.json). The override panel must be testable in isolation (rendered view + persisted form) without touching the verifier or the cycle flow.

in_scope: Picker surface in the Autopilot lane: list drivable milestones from `mp list milestones` filtered by `lifecycle ∈ {approved, in-progress, remediation}` (per A1's session.json model); cursor navigation via existing `tab_move_*` keybinds; toggle selection (`space`); preserve selection insertion order so the queue passed to `mp autopilot start` matches what the user picked (M179 precedent).

Per-drive override panel: a separate buffer (e.g., `<o>` to open) that captures topology (3-agent default), per-role model/harness/skill/extras overrides for orchestrator, runner, and reviewer, and refresh interval (default 2s). Validation: numeric refresh_secs; non-empty role names; harness in {opencode, cursor, pi}.

Persistence: on `Start` (`<s>` from the picker), the picker + override values are written into session.json as `config_overrides` + `roles.<role>` per-session overrides (A1's schema). The dry-run preflight (`mp autopilot --dry-run <ids>` from C2's verifier) honors the overrides.
Refusal paths: empty selection refuses to Start; `mp autopilot session list` shows the new session with its override values.
out_of_scope: Live status graph (per-pane rendering, verifier-event rendering) — D3.
Auto-refresh of the picker / panel — E.

acceptance_criteria.description: Picker renders drivable milestones from `mp list milestones`, filtered to the autopilot-eligible lifecycles; toggle selection preserves insertion order; cursor moves correctly across the list.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p raul --test autopilot_picker --no-fail-fast exit 0 (9/9 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Override panel captures topology, refresh interval, and per-role model/harness/skill/extras. Empty model/skill values mean inherit; unknown harness, invalid topology, malformed extras, and non-positive refresh values are rejected before persistence.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p raul --test autopilot_overrides_validation --no-fail-fast exit 0 (15/15 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: On Start, overrides persist to the new session and win over project defaults for that session; a second session without overrides uses project defaults. Both effective configurations are asserted through dry-run/session show.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p raul --test autopilot_override_precedence --no-fail-fast exit 0 (10/10 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Past-session mode consumes `mp autopilot session list/show`, never reads plan files directly, and opens a read-only replay shell backed by session events. M216 may enrich the shared detail renderer without being required for this milestone.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p raul --test autopilot_session_replay --no-fail-fast exit 0 (10/10 pass)

design_decisions.choice: Override panel is a separate buffer (own keybind map) rather than an in-place editor; `esc` returns to the picker.
design_decisions.rationale: Avoids cross-contamination of keybinds between list navigation and form editing; matches M179's surface pattern.

design_decisions.choice: Inline validation: each field rejects invalid input before the user can leave it; overrides are persisted only when all fields pass.
design_decisions.rationale: Prevents half-formed session.json from polluting plan state; bad input is local to the panel.
